messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Nathan. Your Harlo H15 Dual on order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. It ships by November 30, and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes out in the same box.

Your unit is waiting on the incoming H15 batch for our US warehouse. As soon as it ships, the tracking number will come to this email.

You can watch that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Says delivered, this date has changed 2x already.

Sorry, Nathan. You're right that the date has moved, and I know that's frustrating.

Your H15 Dual hasn't shipped yet. Our warehouse shows the unit still waiting on stock. There's no shipment or tracking on the order, so it can't have been delivered to you. Your ship date is still November 30.

Where are you seeing "delivered"? Is it in an email, on the shipment status page, or in PayPal? Once I know, I can check it and tell you what it's actually showing.
On the link you sent me, that it's been delivered to harlo

That line isn't your order, Nathan. It's in the "Product samples to Harlo" section of the page. Those are test units sent to our hardware lab, Harlo Labs, so the team can check them before the main run. "Delivered to Harlo" means the samples reached the lab, then they move into testing.

Your H15 Dual is part of the launch orders, which ship to customers. It hasn't shipped yet and goes out by November 30. Tracking comes to your email as soon as it leaves.
Handed to the team · No reason for the H15 delay is on record; will not guess. Customer was frustrate

I can't tell you exactly why from what I have, and I'm not going to guess. The H15 Dual is a new unit, and the first samples only just reached Harlo Labs for testing before the main run. Your ship date has moved twice, now to November 30, and that's on us.

I've asked the team for the real reason behind the delay and whether November 30 still holds. Someone will pick up your ticket and send you the answer at (email hidden)

---

**Notes for you (not part of the reply):**

- **The "delivered" mix-up:** the order shows nothing has shipped, and the warehouse shows the H15 still waiting on stock. The "Delivered to Harlo" line Nathan saw is in the page's "Product samples to Harlo" section, which tracks test units sent to the lab. The ops notes say so, but I couldn't open the page to check his screen myself.
- **The ship date:** it moved from November 14 to November 30 on October 25, the same day the price dropped from $999 to $799. Nothing on record says why it moved, so I didn't give him a reason.
- **The flag:** I sent it as a `question` so Georges or Abel can give him the real reason. I didn't offer a swap, a credit or a code. Nathan only asked why it's taking so long, and November 30 is still in the future.

handoffs: No reason for the H15 delay is on record; will not guess. Customer was frustrate
